messages.content: Make one native ask_user tool call requesting the customer information in the quoted message. Use the matching allowed field categories. Do not answer the message, do not invent facts, and do not output plain text.
{"customer_information_request": "I need your email or full name and ZIP to locate your account and orders. Could you please provide that information?"}

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Request missing customer information. Use this tool instead of asking a question in normal text. Pause and wait for the customer. fields must use the listed categories.

arguments.question: Could you please provide your full name and email address?
